findings: Non-blocking: the 0.5 single-name coverage tier yields +40, below the +45 Latin structure bonus. Harmless for the tested cases (competing titles take the -120 pure-title penalty) but could let a title win if it ever carries only the structure bonus. Consider raising the single-name tier or its multiplier in a future tune.

Non-blocking: the demotion's startsKnownSurname guard reuses the CJK-only _commonChineseSurnames set against a Latin token, so it never fires on the Latin demotion path it guards. Behavior is still correct (real Latin names are protected by coverage > 0), but the guard is effectively dead code and diverges from the plan's intended general surname check. Optionally drop or replace with a Latin surname check.
